item.title: Pantograph 1.1.7
item.description:
New

  • Updates install themselves. Pantograph now downloads new versions quietly in the background and installs them when you quit, so there's nothing to click: next time you open it, it's up to date. To be asked first instead, turn off "Download and install updates in the background" in Settings › Updates.

If you have Pantograph 1.1.3 or later, it will offer this update by itself. Otherwise, download Pantograph-1.1.7.zip, unzip it and drag Pantograph to Applications. Requires macOS 13 or later; runs natively on Apple silicon and Intel. Signed and notarized by Apple.
